parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of a bucket, typically made of metal for strength and durability. It is a curved rod attached to the upper rim of the bucket.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, providing a comfortable grip and balance when filled with contents.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can pivot or rotate around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, typically made of plastic. It has a conical shape with a wide opening at the top and a flat base at the bottom.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds liquids or solids, serving as the main container portion of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a rigid, non-moving part that provides structural support and containment for the bucket’s contents.
